title: Craftable Mob Heads
description: Adds crafting recipes for mob heads.
body:
Craftable Mob Heads is a data pack that adds crafting recipes for mob heads. It's that simple.

## FAQ
**Q**: Is it resource-heavy?\
**A**: Nope.

**Q**: Will it make my server slow?\
**A**: Nah.

**Q**: Can I redistribute this on a another platform?\
**A**: As long as it's distributed noncommercially and you give proper credit.
